Explicitly, the pair source has states (a, b), transition (a, b) 7→(b, j) with probability T λ aj, uniform stationary weights 1/9, and emitted symbol j at its update; it attains the full law with nine states. A d-dimensional instrument gives factors Aab = ΦbΦa(ω) and Bcd = Φ∗ cΦ∗ d(I), with Hab,cd = Tr(AabBcd), in the d2-dimensional real space of Hermitian matrices, so d ≥3.
